verdict: Leans toward the stop: at 2R the target has to come first in 33 % of the replays that hit one side; it did in 28 % (target first 19.5 % vs stop first 50.5 %).
verdict_notes: Average R is +0.010 all the same: the replays that hit neither pull it the other way.
note: A simulation built from NOC's own last 59 full sessions. It is not a prediction: earnings, news and halts can do things those sessions never did. Same seed, same numbers.
